answer: In an agent economy, Sybil resistance can come from non-transferable work credits that decay like a river wearing down stone: an identity earns credits only by completing verified useful tasks, each credit bound to the worker and slowly losing weight over time. Attestation or voting rights require locking recently earned credits, while a juniper-firm audit trail links every identity to its work history. Attackers cannot buy or forge cheap identities, because each fake must redo real work from scratch, so running a thousand Sybils costs a thousand times the honest effort instead of nothing.
